english_draft:
NVIDIA published FY2026 Q4 results on 25 February 2026. This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only public information available before the cutoff.

The baseline is the prior quarter. Revenue was $68.1 billion. Data Center revenue was $62.3 billion. Gaming revenue was $3.7 billion. GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 75.2%.

For Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA guided revenue to $78.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. GAAP gross margin is expected to be 74.9%, plus or minus 50 basis points. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be 75.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points. The guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. Starting in Q1 FY2027, non-GAAP results will include stock-based compensation.

Three questions are key. First, the guided midpoint implies about 14.5% sequential revenue growth. This is lower than the 20% growth in Q4. The zero-China assumption may be the main cause. Second, the non-GAAP measure change makes the reported profit not comparable with prior quarters. The scope of change is about $1.9 billion of stock-based compensation in operating expenses. Third, the zero-China assumption reduces the data-center outlook. The company did not disclose its China revenue amount, so the effect is unknown.

Upside risks are stronger demand for Blackwell and early interest in Rubin. Downside risks are a weaker Gaming segment, higher costs from new products, and the zero-China assumption. The report should be checked against the revenue midpoint and the gross-margin range.
reader_questions: 为什么 Q1 指引隐含的环比增速较 Q4 下降？这是需求减弱，还是中国收入零假设导致的？
非 GAAP 口径开始纳入股权激励后，EPS 与上季的 $1.62 不可直接比较，应如何调整上季基数？
游戏收入在 Q4 已环比下降 13%，Q1 是否会继续走弱，并拖累整体毛利率？
fact_checks: 日期与季度：核对 NVIDIA 新闻稿，发布于 2026-02-25，财季为 FY2026 Q4（截至 2026-01-25），目标前瞻季度为 FY2027 Q1，与用户提供的 target_event_date 2026-05-20 对应。
上季收入与分部：新闻稿明确写下季度收入 $68,127M，环比 +20%、同比 +73%；数据中心 $62.3B，环比 +22%、同比 +75%；游戏 $3.7B，环比 -13%、同比 +47%。均与本文引用一致。
毛利率与 EPS：Q4 GAAP 毛利率 75.0%、非 GAAP 75.2%，GAAP EPS $1.76、非 GAAP EPS $1.62，来源一致。
FY2027 Q1 指引：来源明确收入 $78.0B ±2%；GAAP/非GAAP 毛利率 74.9%/75.0% ±50bp，含 0.1% 股权激励影响；GAAP/非GAAP 经营费用约 $7.7B/$7.5B，含 $1.9B 股权激励；税率 17%-19%。
非 GAAP 口径变化：来源明确自 FY2027 Q1 起非 GAAP 不再排除股权激励。本文据此说明 EPS 不可直接比较，且未编造数字。
中国假设：来源明确表示指引不假设任何来自中国的数据中心计算收入。本文指出该假设压低收入中枢，但未量化，因为公司未披露中国数据中心收入金额。
未使用财报后信息：本文仅使用所附 2026-02-25 官方新闻稿，未包含此后任何信息；未引用市场共识或股价预测。
